question: How is Chicago doing?
answer_text:
smart_toy

Scope: focus: SH11 – Chicago, IL (from your question); 2025 → 2029 (first and last years in the data); physical stores only (the website is a separate channel; excluded unless asked); all categories; all Market tiers.

Findings

20 of 20 stores compared declined between 2025 and 2029.
SH11 – Chicago, IL (4-Large): $539,740.00 in 2025 → $179,130.00 in 2029 (-66.81%). Within 4-Large it ranks 1 of 3 (1 = largest decline); the 4-Large median change was -47.27%, so it is 19.54 points below its tier's median.
Median change by Market tier: 1-Small -48.58% (6 stores); 2-Minor -48.06% (6 stores); 3-Medium -48.45% (5 stores); 4-Large -47.27% (3 stores).

Interpretation

Every store compared declined, so the question is how much, not whether.
Revenue is not profit: costs are not in the data.
Compares 2025 with 2029 only; the years in between are not used.
Stores differ in size (Market tier), so compare percentage change, and compare a store with others in the same tier (its rank within the tier and the tier medians).
The website (SH00) is excluded by default because it is a different sales channel; choose the Website channel to include it.
A change in revenue does not explain why it changed; the reasons are not in the data.
